LanguageData.VGE_AirlockDoor.label: airlock door (1x1)
LanguageData.VGE_AirlockDoor.description: A specialized, heavily reinforced door that functions as a physical security barrier and an automated atmospheric seal. When powered, it ensures a rapid, safe transition between pressurized and vacuum areas by maintaining an atmospheric seal and managing pressure during operation. Colonists will not cross it without required vacuum resistance.
